from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyAssetInfo(BaseModel):
    """Financial asset data extracted from a single company's financial statement."""
    company_name: str = Field(description="The name of the company filing the report")
    total_assets_amount: float = Field(description="The numeric value of Total Assets as reported")
    total_assets_unit: str = Field(description="The unit scale of the amount (e.g., 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions')")
    report_date: str = Field(description="The period end date or date of the financial statement")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim text snippet containing the Total Assets figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_asset_info: list[CompanyAssetInfo]
